label: copy phase: fed-back input m (mid-recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during the original tokens or at <DEL>), and only when the input is a repeat token (in_first=0 everywhere it fires). It never fires at recall_idx 0 and almost never at 1, and never when to_go >= 7. The dominant driver is the fed-back input m: about 55% of activation mass, 14x lift, and every top activation (around 0.9-1.0 of max) is m as copy input at recall_idx 3, i.e. orig(2)=m. Weaker, more diffuse activations come from inputs 1, e, j, v, 0 and from outputs j, m, i, v, a. Rate peaks at t=12 and at recall_idx 3-5. Precision is low: m in the copy phase is inactive about 60% of the time, so the full condition is not captured.
